title: proc-sim-agent: an Agent Skill for Aspen Plus process simulation
description: proc-sim-agent is an open-source Agent Skill (agentskills.io) that helps chemical engineers work in Aspen Plus with a coding agent such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot. It grounds answers in the user's own locally installed Aspen Plus help and example library, simulation files and literature: a full-text index of the local help and of the example models; readers for run history, report, Control Panel and backup files, with a check that they come from the same run; stream balance and KPI checks against expected values; staged model building; an input-file writer workflow with a checker; inline-Fortran checks; Aspen Plus automation (COM) on copies of a model; and a curated knowledge base of run messages and calculator practice. No vendor content is distributed.
